stem: A paper airplane was thrown from the top of a tall building. The height of the paper airplane above the ground can be found using the function y = -1.5x + 60, where x is the time in seconds the airplane has been in the air.
instruction:
How many seconds did it take the paper airplane to reach the ground?

Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document.
